knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Looking at the stain with the client and confirming in writing avoids an unchecked promise.
The first step is to listen and acknowledge, then check the job record before any offer.
A complaint record shows what happened, what was done and whether the client was satisfied, and it reveals repeat problems.

practicalCriteria: Learner role-plays a supplied complaint and records date, detail, action, outcome and follow-up date.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical criteria signed off separately by an assessor
evidenceRequired: Completed artefact saved with date and version
Assessor record of knowledge check result
stopWorkCriteria: Learner treats a tax, licence, privacy or consumer law point as settled without checking it
